summary.ru: «Сражающаяся Франция», до июля 1942 года — «Свободная Франция» — патриотическое движение французов за освобождение Франции от нацистской Германии в 1940—1944 годах. Военные, примкнувшие к этому движению, образовали Свободные французские силы.
summary.en: Free France was a resistance government claiming to be the legitimate government of France following the dissolution of the Third Republic during World War II. Led by General Charles de Gaulle, Free France was established as a government-in-exile in London in June 1940 after the Fall of France to Nazi Germany. It joined the Allied nations in fighting Axis forces with the (Forces françaises libres) ("Free French Forces"; FFF), supported the Resistance in Nazi-occupied France, known as the French Forces of the Interior, and gained strategic footholds in several French colonies in Africa.
